I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread. I didn't record 25 November as the Brackenwater renewal date, because the records say otherwise:

- **Signed 2025–2026 renewal order form:** the renewal date is 30 November 2026.
- **Account page** (owner Marcus Lindqvist, last updated 30 Sep): also says 30 November.
- **CRM note from 10 February 2026:** says 31 December 2026, which matches neither.

I asked Ilse whether 25 November comes from an amendment or from the customer, and suggested she check with Marcus. Until she points to a document, the date of record stays 30 November.

All of these are North team records, so Ilse can see them. I only mentioned dates and the account owner, with no prices or other finance figures.
